title: Japan vs Taiwan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Japan for the full bucket-list experience and variety; Taiwan for budget, friendliness, and easy exploration. Do both if you're in Asia for 3+ weeks.

categories.name: Daily Budget (mid-range)
categories.summary: Taiwan runs $40–70/day vs Japan's $80–150/day. The yen's weakness has narrowed the gap, but Taiwan still wins on value.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Japan has the world's most Michelin stars and unmatched food diversity. Taiwan's night markets and beef noodle soup are world-class in their own right.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Japan's scale gives it an edge — Alps, Hokkaido wilderness, Yakushima. But Taiwan's Taroko Gorge is genuinely one of Asia's greatest natural wonders.

faq.question: Is Japan or Taiwan better for first-time visitors to Asia?
faq.answer: Taiwan is often recommended for first-timers because of lower costs, English accessibility, and a more compact size. Japan offers more variety but requires more planning and budget.
